archetypes.name: progress-routing
archetypes.rationale: ship-pr state now bypasses phase filtering and should not regress Step 5 fallbacks
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the progress-report routing around implement runs. Verify that ship-pr-state.sh presence reliably selects the ship-pr renderer while preserving the Step 5 fallback behavior when the state file is absent. Pay close attention to empty PHASE handling and stale timing marks. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
